title: Who leads a band: trumpet, sax or clarinet, and Picou
summary: De De explains the leader is usually trumpet, sometimes sax, and earlier clarinet, citing Picou.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: One thing I never could understand, how does a band get organized on something like that? How do you know who's going to play the lead?

Oh well that's in front. See like mostly a man says he's got his job and other boys, well he tends to probably the money proposition, the money part of it, but mostly the trumpet player will lead that band. Now if they figured sax is a stronger man in other words, you know, I'd let him lead the band, follow him. Follow him. But mostly between the trumpets and the sax, you know. And they used to be clarinet before, clarinet and trumpet. They would do the most leading instruments.
Well who did the lead on clarinet in the old days?
Oh like all the more fellas like we mentioned there in Piku. He would play the lead?
He would play the lead, so?

Oh yes indeed, the lead band was sure. He had a lot of work in it, because Piku would run his band and let it live where he wanted, you know. Fragile music like he wanted. Cut it up whatever he wanted to do. He had that part to do.
